name: wasm3
description: wasm3 WebAssembly interpreter (github.com/wasm3/wasm3 @ 28ecb9af, MIT), vendored for Pocket Hub apps. M3_IN_IRAM leaves the interpreter in flash: the ESP32 default (IRAM_ATTR on every opcode) costs ~59 KB of heap from boot. Code pages of 4 KB instead of 32 KB: a small app no longer pins 32-64 KB of compiled code.
